mathematics.assertion_tested: For the carry-gated frozen execution mode on 5 learner seeds x 32 natural starts, recompute exact expected success and discounted return at overwrite probabilities 0, 0.05, 0.30, and 1 from recorded fixed-kernel paths.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Decimal arithmetic at 50 digits for the independent aggregate; binary64/JAX values in the recorded run.
mathematics.conventions: Discount 0.995; terminal success reward represented by 0.995^(T-1); independent overwrite survival (1-p)^k; one physical grain loss makes the three-grain goal impossible.
non_claims: The evaluator supplied the carry gate; the policy did not learn when to switch.
The result does not isolate state-distribution shift as the cause of the late-switch failure.
The exact p=0.05 and p=0.30 values are finite-panel expectations from deterministic fixed paths, not fresh stochastic rollouts.
Five Dual-history learner seeds do not establish population frequency or significance.

residual_risks: The policy network and simulator implementation were not independently reimplemented.
The intermediate-probability result relies on the environment property that any overwrite loss makes the delivery goal impossible.
The supplied phase gate is not an autonomous switching method.
result: Implementation and finite assertion verified in the stated five-seed, 32-start panel.
